title: SmartCompany (2011): Convert Wikipedia articles into PDF files

steps.quote: On the left hand side of the screen, you should see a link that says “**Print/Export**”.
steps.text: On the left hand side of the screen, you should see a link that says “Print/Export”.
steps.goal: The article's print and export options are shown

steps.quote: Click this, and you’ll see some options – you’ll want to click on “**Download as PDF**”.
steps.text: Click this, and you’ll see some options – you’ll want to click on “Download as PDF”.
steps.goal: A page offering to download the article as a PDF is shown
